title: David Booth on Investing, Dimensional and Staying Calm | The David Rubenstein Show

Today, Dimensional manages more than $1 trillion. title: Lula Plans $28 Billion Debt Buyout to Aid Consumers Before Vote
summary: Brazil’s government plans to spend 15 billion reais to buy as much as 150 billion reais ($28 billion) of delinquent consumer debt from banks, part of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s push to ease the financial strain on households and bolster his bid for a fourth term.

title: Ellison Pledges $9.2 Billion More in Oracle Shares for Loans
summary: Larry Ellison, a key figure behind Paramount Skydance Corp.’s deal to buy Warner Bros. Discovery Inc., has pledged 67 million more shares of Oracle Corp. as collateral for personal loans than he had at the same time last year.

title: Search for the Next Leader of the UN
summary: UN Secretary General Antonio Guterres' term ends this year, and three Security Council straw polls have provided no consensus. Guyana’s Permanent Representative to the UN Carolyn Rodrigues-Birkett is one of the top contenders. She speaks to Bloomberg Businessweek Daily about why she wants the job, and how she views the UN's role in the world moving forward. (Source: Bloomberg)
